en: Many people enjoy parks. Some parks have playgrounds. Other parks are quiet. I prefer a quiet park.
My ideal park has many trees. Children can play there. Adults can rest under the trees. This park can help everyone relax.
zh: 許多人喜歡公園。有些公園有遊樂場，另一些很安靜。我偏好安靜的公園。
我的理想公園有許多樹。孩子可以玩耍，大人可以在樹下休息，這座公園能讓大家放鬆。

en: Parks offer different ways to relax. Some have playgrounds, while others provide a quiet setting. I prefer a peaceful park.
My ideal park would have plenty of trees. Children could play while adults rested in the shade. It would be a welcoming place for everyone.
zh: 公園提供不同的放鬆方式。有些有遊樂場，另一些有安靜的環境。我偏好寧靜的公園。
我的理想公園會有許多樹。孩子玩耍時，大人可以在樹蔭下休息。這會是歡迎大家的地方。
